title: More ways to generate speech
summary:
A lot of audio today: multi-speaker dialogue, voice editing, timestamped speech, and a new realtime model.

ElevenLabs dialogue adds multi-speaker audio from up to 25 text turns and 10 voices. A separate speech endpoint returns audio with character-level timestamps for ElevenLabs v3, Flash v2.5, and Multilingual v2.

Voice Changer transforms a recording’s voice while keeping its timing and delivery. Voice Isolator removes background sound from audio or video while preserving speech.

`gpt-realtime-2.1-mini` joins the realtime WebSocket route with text, audio, and image input; text and audio output; tool use; and a 128K-token context window. Usage accounting also distinguishes cached audio and image tokens.

highlights.title: Multi-speaker dialogue
highlights.text: Generate audio from up to 25 text turns and 10 voices with `eleven-dialogue` at `POST /v1/audio/dialogue`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=eleven-dialogue).

highlights.title: Change a recorded voice
highlights.text: Send a recording to `POST /v1/audio/voice-changer` to change its voice while keeping the original timing and delivery. Preset and custom ElevenLabs voices are supported. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Isolate speech from noise
highlights.text: Send audio or video to `POST /v1/audio/voice-isolator` to remove background sound and get speech back as MP3. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: GPT Realtime 2.1 Mini
highlights.text: Use `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini` over `/v1/realtime` with text, audio, or image input, plus text or audio output and tool use. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-realtime-2.1-mini).

highlights.title: Speech with character timestamps
highlights.text: Use `POST /v1/audio/speech/with-timestamps` to get ElevenLabs speech with audio and character-level timing for original and normalized text. It supports v3, Flash v2.5, and Multilingual v2. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
